#Citizenship

🔺️ BY DESCENT

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after January 26, 1950 but before December 10, 1992 is a citizen of India by descent, if his father was a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ A person born outside India on or after December 10, 1992 is considered as a citizen of India if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ December 3, 2004 onwards, a person born outside India shall not be a citizen of India by descent, unless his birth is registered at an Indian consulate within one year of the date of birth or with the permission of the 
Central Government, after the expiry of the said period.

Mahadevi Verma is known as the ‘Modern Meera of Hindi poetry’.

2. मोबाइल का आविष्कार मार्टिन कूपर ने किया था।
The mobile phone was invented by Martin Cooper.

The mixture of potassium nitrate, charcoal, and sulfur is called gunpowder.

5. बिहार प्रांत के गठन आंदोलन का नेतृत्व सच्चिदानंद सिन्हा ने किया था।

7. गुजरात और सिंध के तट से लगा 60 किमी लंबा दलदली क्षेत्र सर क्रीक कहलाता है।
The 60 km long marshy area along Gujarat and Sindh coast is called Sir Creek.

8. कीटनाशी गैसों को फैलाने की प्रक्रिया को फ्यूमीगेशन कहा जाता है।
The process of spreading insecticidal gases is called fumigation.

9. PURA योजना वर्ष 2003 में शुरू की गई थी।
The PURA scheme was launched in 2003.

10. लोदी काल की सबसे महत्वपूर्ण मस्जिद मोठ की मस्जिद है।
The most important mosque of the Lodi period is Moth ki Masjid.

Green plants are the largest utilizers of solar energy.

Provisions related to the Inter-State Council are mentioned in Article 263 of the Constitution.
